content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Birmingham

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree (high school diploma, associate degree, or global equivalent) and completion of project management education hours. Crucially, no prior work experience is required—making CAPM ideal for career-changers and early-stage professionals entering Birmingham's competitive job market.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of PM Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp-style course. Delivered entirely online, this intensive format fits working schedules and eliminates commute time, allowing you to earn your required contact hours from anywhere while maintaining your current role.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing coursework, submit your CAPM application directly to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy guides you through each requirement, ensuring your documentation is complete and your application moves forward without delay.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources to review PMBOK® Guide concepts, practice questions, and test-taking strategies. When ready, schedule your proctored exam and demonstrate your mastery of core project-management knowledge to earn your credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM certification lasts three years. Maintain your credential by earning professional development units (PDUs) through continued learning, volunteering, or additional certifications. Granite PM Academy offers resources to help you stay current and prepare for advancement to PMP® when you gain work experience.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
